title: Starckfolio
tagline: A personalized and comprehensive dashboard for your Starknet Portfolio
description: The idea was to create a dashboard that gives a comprehensive view of your Starknet portfolio. Analytics of your assets, balance, and NFTs would be visualized so that you can get a clear view. Current market rates, graphs, and analysis tools would be made easy. But the project is incomplete.
how_its_made: The login was to be made using Dynamic. The account address would be passed to the Dynamic API to fetch wallet details and transaction history. The front-end was going to be made with React and these account details would be visualized using React libraries. The hardhat ethereum boilerplate was used for the starter code
